title: Professional Packing Services & Removal Materials Birmingham
metaTitle: Packing Services & Materials Birmingham | Jimmys Removals
metaDescription: Full and partial packing services across Birmingham & West Midlands. High-grade double-walled cartons, wardrobe boxes, bubble wrap and china wrapping.
heroSubheading: Professional packing services in Birmingham, from fragile-only kitchen packing to full-home packing the day before your move. We supply double-walled boxes, wardrobe cartons, tissue and bubble wrap, and can deliver self-pack box kits if you'd rather pack yourself.
summary: Packing up your home is often the most time-consuming stage of moving house. Our trained Birmingham movers and packers supply double-walled cardboard cartons, hanging wardrobe boxes, acid-free tissue paper, and bubble wrap to protect your cherished possessions. Choose between fragile-only kitchen china wrapping or comprehensive full-home packing services completed the day before move day, ensuring your furniture and delicate glassware arrive at your new property completely undamaged.
benefits: Full-house, kitchen-only, or fragile-only packing packages
Heavy-duty double-walled cardboard boxes designed for removals
Acid-free tissue paper and anti-static bubble wrap for delicate china
Hanging wardrobe boxes to keep clothing pristine and crease-free

process.title: Survey & Material Estimation
process.description: We calculate the exact volume and types of packing boxes, tape, bubble wrap, and wardrobe cartons required for your home.

process.title: Delivery or Packing Day
process.description: We either deliver moving kits in advance for self-packing or arrive the day prior to moving to pack entire rooms efficiently.

process.title: Specialist Item Wrapping
process.description: Fragile glassware, bone china, picture frames, and electronics are individually cushioned and safely packed into reinforced cartons.

process.title: Structured Labelling & Placement
process.description: Every box is catalogued with contents and designated destination rooms, ensuring effortless unloading at your new property.

whatsIncluded: Full supply of double-walled corrugated cardboard boxes
Specialist packing tape, bubble wrap, and clean tissue paper
Portable hanging wardrobe cartons for coats and suits
Experienced packers handling delicate and high-value items
Transit insurance coverage on all items packed by our team
whatsNotIncluded: Packing of perishable food from freezers on pre-move days
Packing of flammable gases, paints, lighter fluids or fuel cans
Unpacking into closed internal cupboards unless pre-arranged
Safe disposal of customer discarded domestic refuse
priceNotes: Achievable price for a fragile-only packing package (kitchen glassware, china, lamps, and pictures) for a 2-bedroom home.

faqs.question: Can I buy packing boxes from you if I prefer to pack myself?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer self-pack moving kits containing assorted small, medium, and large double-walled boxes, tape, bubble wrap, and marker pens delivered across Birmingham.

faqs.question: When does the packing service take place?
faqs.answer: For larger homes (3+ bedrooms), we usually complete packing the day before your move. For 1-2 bedroom properties, we can often pack earlier on moving morning.

faqs.question: Are my breakables covered by insurance if you pack them?
faqs.answer: Yes. When our professional team packs your fragile items, they are fully covered under our Fully insured Fully insured policy. Self-packed boxes are covered against vehicle transit incidents but not internal packing shifts.

faqs.question: Do you offer an unpacking service at our new home?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can unpack boxes onto flat surfaces and clear away empty cardboard cartons and wrapping paper on the same day.
